method.sentinel: /var/tmp/s2-u0/bin/sentinel.py (sha256 1bc7c6a1b837855e4634c340c8432ab54315294c110cd422d24152d55e9450e1): one uniquely named tool per sentinel; logs start, initialize, tools/list, tools/call, other requests and exit
method.verdict_source: sentinel lifecycle logs; harness-reported listings (Claude init event, Codex/dsh request tool lists captured by a local proxy); never the model's words
method.disposable_environment: env -i with HOME, USER, LOGNAME, SHELL, TERM, LANG, PATH, TMPDIR, DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER and per-harness names only; throwaway HOME, CODEX_HOME, DSH_HOME and project per harness under /var/tmp/s2-u0
method.etc_layers: managed and system sources under /etc were planted only inside a bubblewrap mount namespace whose /etc is a tmpfs of host entries bound back read-only plus the planted directory; host /etc unchanged
method.local_model_route: Codex and dsh model calls went to the shared local Spark server (GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3, OpenAI-compatible, checks no key) through /var/tmp/s2-u0/bin/capture-proxy.py (sha256 6f77ee1c9387bbeaba12f2c0d35bd393d0514dd686d9e20c6f2810151af972ca), which logs the tool list each request carries and, for Codex only, drops the unsupported include field and flattens namespace tools (restoring namespaced calls on the way back)
method.lanetally_route: plainly fake ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9 (nothing listens): MCP startup is observed, no provider request is made

claude.init: type=system subtype=init: session_id, tools[], mcp_servers[{name,status,source}] with source user|project|plugin|enterprise|claudeai|dynamic
claude.call: type=assistant event whose message.content holds one tool_use block {type,id:toolu_*,name,input}; mcp names are mcp__<server>__<tool>, plugin servers mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__<tool>; one block per event, several events share message.id
claude.result: type=user event: message.content tool_result {tool_use_id,content,is_error} plus top-level tool_use_result (MCP: content array; Bash: {stdout,stderr,interrupted,isImage,noOutputExpected})
claude.repetition: one tool_use and one tool_result per call; no start/complete pair
claude.deferred_discovery: with default tools Claude called native ToolSearch (query select:mcp__engine__u0_engine_probe, result tool_reference) before the MCP call (C05); under --tools "" MCP tools were listed and called directly
claude.resume_replay: C08 re-announced C05's session_id and emitted only new tool_use ids; C05's toolu ids were not replayed

codex.mcp_call: item.started then item.completed with the same item.id: {id:item_N,type:mcp_tool_call,server,tool,arguments,result:{content,structured_content}|null,error:{message}|null,status:in_progress|completed|failed}
codex.ids: item.id is a per-invocation sequence restarting at item_0 on every invocation including resume; the model call_id appears only in the rollout file (function_call {name,namespace:mcp__<server>,call_id})
codex.gap: X08: an exec_command call (exit 1) is in the rollout but produced no command_execution item in the exec JSONL
codex.model_facing: MCP servers reach the model as Responses API namespace tools (one per server, nested function tools); no defer_loading under fallback model metadata; features tool_search and tool_search_always_defer_mcp_tools report removed in 0.160.0
codex.resume_replay: X04/X05: same thread_id, only new items emitted; history is resent to the model but not re-emitted as events
codex.pending: deferred discovery for OpenAI catalogue models (PENDING OPERATOR APPROVAL)

dsh.stream: headless stdout carries only the final message; events come from the session transcript (session-persistence-jsonl root, compression none)
dsh.mcp_vs_native: same event types; MCP identified only by name mcp__<serverName>__<tool>
dsh.repetition: one call and one result event per call
dsh.resume_replay: unmeasured (no resume option in the installed headless app)
